title: FrameRef: A Framing Dataset and Simulation Testbed for Modeling Bounded Rational Information Health
reasoning: The paper focuses on linguistic and cognitive framing dimensions (authoritative, consensus, emotional, prestige, and sensationalist) and their impact on information health. It explicitly excludes 'moralizing' frames from its study and does not evaluate religious or spiritual traditions, or formal ethical systems as a core component of its dataset or framework.
